complete52_geometry.complete_literal_body_paragraph: **SUMIRE-P001.** Sumire makes training a way to offer care, seek company and enjoy work. The difficulty is not that these motives are false. A café visit can provide cute cake and plush pleasure while only partly satisfying a wish to talk about something other than exercise. Paid stadium work can be wanted novelty, and a written cat-doll wish can matter without producing a useful object.
